summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican printed a London special on Tom Allen's victory over Charley Davis at St. George's Hall the previous Thursday for the championship of the world and £200 a side, won in five rounds.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Monday Morning, April 8, 1878, page 8 — the Missouri Republican (not yet the St. Louis Republic)

facts.fact: Allen defeated Charley Davis, champion of the United Kingdom, at St. George's Hall for the championship of the world and £200 a side; Davis was knocked down senseless in the fifth round and the referee declared Allen the winner after cries of foul; the fight lasted eighteen and a half minutes

notes: Same London account as 610 with an added intro calling Allen a St. Louisan and noting betting of £25 to £20 against him. Sides of the clipping are cut off; a wider recrop from the full page would recover the lost words.
